primary_hypothesis.name: extreme_isolation_topology_regime_switch
primary_hypothesis.statement: After a strong ecological reference is supplied, the incremental held-out effect of a species-conditioned structural coordinate is more favourable in the upper 25% of a response-independent isolation distribution than in the remaining eligible units.
primary_hypothesis.extreme_isolation_rule: upper 25% of the frozen eligible-unit isolation distribution computed from predictor-only data before response access
primary_hypothesis.primary_contrast: mean candidate-minus-reference held-out loss in extreme-isolation units minus mean candidate-minus-reference held-out loss in non-extreme units

predeclared_robustness.success_rule: robustness thresholds cannot rescue a failed 0.75 primary

secondary_source_decoupling_hypothesis.name: source_conditioned_excess_connectivity
secondary_source_decoupling_hypothesis.statement: Within extreme-isolation units, topology increment is more favourable when source-conditioned connectivity exceeds the generic species-independent connectivity representation already present in the reference.

required_definitions.generic_connectivity: one response-independent species-independent connectivity/stepping representation frozen before response access
required_definitions.source_conditioned_connectivity: the same graph/operator conditioned only on outer-training or otherwise prospectively permitted focal-species sources

secondary_multihop_hypothesis.name: multi_hop_source_path
secondary_multihop_hypothesis.statement: Source-conditioned topology is most informative when the focal unit is connected to an occupied source through a multi-hop path even though direct source distance exceeds the smallest frozen graph scale.
secondary_multihop_hypothesis.definition: connected at the smallest frozen graph scale AND nearest permitted source distance > that scale

transfer_requirement.cross_origin_generalization: requires same-direction primary extreme-isolation contrast in independently admitted island and fragmentation systems under spatial transfer
transfer_requirement.source_decoupling_generalization: requires a system-specific generic-vs-source-conditioned connectivity pair frozen before response access; island mainland stepping and habitat-fragment connectivity need not share the same operator

anti_selection: do not change the 0.75 primary threshold after future response access
do not choose a generic-connectivity metric after seeing source-conditioned outcomes
do not choose the smallest graph scale after seeing multi-hop subgroup outcomes
do not use source-decoupling or multi-hop secondaries to rescue a failed primary
do not select taxa, sites or systems using candidate-minus-reference direction
do not count A-Islands or Tanzania discovery statistics as future confirmation
